title: Debounced note edits are dropped when a save is already in flight
reproduction: Open a note and change its body; allow the 600 ms debounce to start the update request.
Before that request resolves, make a second body change and wait for its 600 ms debounce to expire.
Let the first request succeed, then reload the note.
expected: The latest draft is eventually persisted, and ‘Saved’ refers to that latest draft.
actual: The second timer calls persist while inflightRef is true; persist returns immediately and discards that snapshot. Completion of the first update marks the earlier snapshot saved and does not schedule a trailing write.
severity: S2: latest user edits can be lost while the UI reports an earlier snapshot saved
